name: Matrix.toLin_self
statement: Matrix m n R) (i : n) : Matrix.toLin v₁ v₂ M (v₁ i) = ∑ j, M j i • v₂ j

name: Matrix.toLin_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement: Type*} [Finite m] [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] {v₁ : Basis n R M₁} {v₂ : Basis m R M₂} {A : Matrix m n R} {x : M₁} : A.toLin v₁ v₂ x = 0 ↔ ∀ j, (A *ᵥ v₁.repr x) j = 0

name: linearMap_apply_apply
statement: ι₂ × ι₁) (k : ι₁) : (b₁.linearMap b₂ ij) (b₁ k) = if ij.2 = k then b₂ ij.1 else 0

name: isStablyFiniteRing_iff_injective_of_surjective
statement: IsStablyFiniteRing A ↔ ∀ n (f : Module.End A (Fin n → A)), Surjective f → Injective f
